svg.title: Exact family sufficiency despite a many-to-one map
svg.desc: What this figure shows: Fixed within-fiber conditionals allow a globally many-to-one map to preserve all pairwise distances on a restricted family. The plotted object is generated from rho_F=0 => d_f=d_c on the declared family. How to read it: compare the labeled axes, curves, contours, matrix entries, bars, or markers exactly as defined in the atlas entry; the visible trend is the numerical realization of the stated equation or construction. Scientific status: Constructive Proposition 18 example. Unless explicitly identified otherwise, this is not empirical consciousness data.
